_comment: Copy to ~/.config/modelfabric/config.json. Every field is optional.
_models_root: Directory scanned for GGUF models. Set this to let ModelFabric load and unload models itself. Empty means route-only.
_llama_server: llama.cpp server binary. A bare name is resolved on PATH, then pinned by content digest.
_state_dir: Ownership records, the operation journal and input pins. Defaults to your user cache dir.
_instance_ports: Port range assigned to models ModelFabric launches.
_engine_defaults: Applied to a load unless the request overrides them.
_engines: Optional: OpenAI-compatible servers you start yourself, which ModelFabric fronts but does not supervise.
_verify_full: Re-hash every pinned model file on every load instead of trusting size+mtime. Off by default: re-hashing 16GB costs seconds.
_tag: Optional Tailscale tag to restrict discovery, e.g. tag:modelfabric. Empty means probe every online peer on mesh_port.
_local_bias: How strongly to favour local engines, in units of outstanding requests. 0.5 means a local engine wins any tie but loses to a peer that is a full request less busy.
